user_confirmation.check_presented: Verified private copy safely stored, with future implementation access excluded from private custodian conversations/tool logs
user_confirmation.basis: User authorized proceeding in response to the explicit combined custody check. This is human authorization, not an independent technical audit of their retained copy or future access isolation.

temporary_cleanup.implementation_access_exclusion: User responsibility: private custodian conversations/tool logs must remain inaccessible to the implementation environment. A fresh chat alone does not establish this.

verification.independent_private_review: pass; separate reviewer recovered and checked the unfinished preparer's package against its captured evidence
verification.complete_internal_checksum_coverage: pass; every payload file covered, no unlisted file or symlink
verification.archive_readback: pass; archived payload bytes match the independently checked internal manifest

release_gate: User verifies the archive and internal manifest and retains a durable copy outside implementation access
User confirms staging/archive copies and custodian/private-agent transcripts and tool logs are removed or inaccessible to the implementation environment
Fresh implementation context receives public development materials only; a fresh chat alone does not prove filesystem or log isolation
Before oracle release record the frozen implementation commit SHA, clean status, dependencies, approved capability configuration and harness/replay hashes
Release this exact verified package only after candidate freeze, recording recipient, time and hashes; no topology-specific logic changes or prebuilt special case receive reuse credit
limitations: The K+R topology and prior readiness exemplar were already disclosed, not unseen
Shared source/model infrastructure and procedural custody do not imply statistical independence or confidentiality against the workstation owner
Captures are sequential, scoped evidence rather than a transactional snapshot, upstream publication-validation attestation or real-world completeness certificate
Diagnostic acquisition does not establish future whole-plan budget fit
Custody/access exclusion rests on the user's authorization; no technical isolation is independently established by file permissions or separate agent sessions
